meta.title: Irreplaceable · Train the part of your job AI gets wrong
meta.description: Your job, task by task: what AI already does, what stays yours, and ten-minute daily reps built from your own work.
meta.ogAlt: AI makes mistakes in your line of work. Can you spot them? The week of a registered nurse, task by task.

hero.title: AI makes mistakes in your line of work. Can you spot them?
hero.titleA: {ai} makes mistakes in your line of work
hero.lead: See which tasks of your week AI already handles, from real usage data. Then train ten minutes a day on what it gets wrong and what it cannot do.

one.title: Tell us your job
one.body: Type your job title or drop your resume. No sign-up.

two.title: See your week
two.body: In about two minutes you get a map of your week: what AI already touches and what stays yours.

three.title: Train ten minutes a day
three.body: Short reps made from your own tasks keep you the one who checks AI.

map.title: Your week map
map.body: Every task of your week, sorted into what AI already does, what it speeds up and what stays yours.
map.caption: A nurse's week, mapped from a sample resume
map.stake: It also shows how much of your pay sits in the tasks AI touches.

reps.title: Daily reps from your own work
reps.body: Ten minutes a day. Each rep is written from one of your tasks and checked right away.
reps.slipBody: Find the mistakes AI left in a document from your job.
reps.delegateBody: Brief AI on a real task and catch the traps in the inputs.
reps.trap: A trap: the same payment is listed twice
reps.edgeBody: Handle the part AI can't: a person who needs an answer now.

game.title: AI or me?
game.body: A free daily game. Guess which of your tasks AI is already used for.

shop.title: Points you can spend
shop.body: Everything you do earns points. Trade them for Pro discounts, free months, or a month of Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus as a pilot reward.

proof.title: Proof for your next review
proof.body: Every finished rep is saved. The Review kit turns them into one page for your manager.

streak.title: Your streak
streak.body: Practice a little every day and watch the week fill up.

pay.title: What you pay for
pay.cup: For Business Cup 2.0, Pro is free until {date}.

data.title: Built on real data
data.onet: Your tasks come from O*NET, the US database of what each job involves.
data.aei: What AI already does comes from the Anthropic Economic Index, built from real AI use at work.
data.bls: Pay comes from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.

closing.title: Find out what makes you irreplaceable
closing.lead: Type your job title. Your week map takes about two minutes.

footer.slogan: Train the part of your job AI gets wrong.
